title: More room to shape generated speech
summary:
New speech controls and two text models landed alongside community apps, updated permission examples, and a Windows MCP process fix.

Added `qwen-tts` and paid-only `qwen-tts-instruct` to the speech API. The instruct model accepts an `instruct` field for emotion and style control, while both models support voice selection.

Added paid-only `claude-opus-4.7` and `kimi-k2.6`. Kimi K2.6 accepts text and images and supports tools and reasoning; the existing `kimi` entry still points to K2.5. Older Claude and Gemini versioned aliases now resolve to their respective large-model entries.

AI Models Laboratory joined the image-app catalog, and Scene2Text joined writing. The README’s Recent Apps section also now credits named contributors for these and other featured apps.

highlights.title: Qwen speech with direction
highlights.text: Generate speech with `qwen-tts`, or use paid-only `qwen-tts-instruct` and its `instruct` field to guide emotion and style. [Browse Qwen TTS models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-tts).

highlights.title: Claude Opus 4.7 added
highlights.text: Use paid-only `claude-opus-4.7` for text generation. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-opus-4.7).

highlights.title: Kimi K2.6 added
highlights.text: Use `kimi-k2.6` with text or image input, tools, reasoning, and a 262,000-token context window. The `kimi` entry still points to K2.5. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kimi-k2.6).
